summary.name: 2.5D Parallax Animation
summary.visualIdentity: Flat artwork is split into foreground, midground and background layers with plausible occlusion. Restrained relative layer motion reveals extra artwork beyond the crop. This is layered parallax, not 3D modeling.
summary.suitableUses: Source-named fits: narrative explainers and children's stories (storybook plates) and historical documentaries (period photo cutouts). Inferred fit: illustrated explainers built from layered artwork, for video or interactive HTML.
summary.limitations: Avoid reversed depth motion, exposed edges and excessive separation. The source review covered sampled seconds 1–8 only, with no audio or continuous motion verified. Strict isometric scenes need translation-only offsets, not camera tilt.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent, chosen from subject and mood. Example tokens #EFE7D6, #34473F and #8A9C85 are unapproved suggestions; no exact colors are specified. Use one dark, low-value hue family per scene with a stable light anchor. Foreground/background contrast is 8.056:1; accent_1 at 3.386:1 is decorative only.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Video uses a timed storyboard with a shared camera transform plus per-layer offsets evaluated from composition time. Optional references: motion-009 (depth-dependent response, pointer input only for interactive delivery), motion-012 (one progress-linked chapter handoff) and motion-015 (narrative step states). Verify direct, backward and forward seeks.
summary.audio: The source does not specify audio. Options include music, voiceover, sung vocals, effects, ambience or silence, chosen per topic and audience; no genre or layer is mandatory. Honor explicit user audio, state assumptions, and keep speech intelligible.
summary.assetRequirements: Layered PNG or SVG with alpha, consistent dimensions, clear naming and a layer manifest, or numbered frames, with overscan beyond the crop. Creature assets are optional for motion-009's hop. Period photos are needed only if supplied; they must never be invented.
summary.combinations: style-030 storybook plates suit a slow camera push. style-044 period photo cutouts suit modest drift. Conflict: style-044 says to tint photos to primary tokens, but palette rules keep source photos unchanged, so tokens apply only to new elements.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the primary pipeline for composition, clip timing, window.__timelines registration, checks, snapshots and delivery rendering. Remotion is a fallback only for a recorded, verified limitation. PixiJS or DOM/SVG renders artwork with explicit repaint on seek; GSAP owns motion; Three.js is only for true 3D; chroma-js validates colors.
